headline: Law Minister says Sheikh Hasina will be arrested if she enters Bangladesh
summary: The Law Minister stated that the former Prime Minister is an accused in cases involving the death penalty, causing her arrest to be mandatory upon her return.
details: Law Minister Sanaul Huq Choudhury has stated that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be arrested immediately upon her entry into Bangladesh.
The Minister explained that she is an accused in several cases where the death penalty is sought, making her arrest a legal necessity.
This statement comes amid ongoing legal proceedings and investigations into the events leading up to her departure from the country.
The government is coordinating with international agencies to ensure that legal processes are follow through in the case of her return.
caption:
Sheikh Hasina will be arrested immediately upon entering Bangladesh, says Law Minister.

Law Minister Sanaul Huq Choudhury has stated that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be arrested immediately upon her entry into Bangladesh.

The Minister explained that she is an accused in several cases where the death penalty is sought, making her arrest a legal necessity.

This statement comes amid ongoing legal proceedings and investigations into the events leading up to her departure from the country.

The government is coordinating with international agencies to ensure that legal processes are follow through in the case of her return.

headline_marked: US military [[launches 'powerful' retaliatory strikes on Iran]]
headline: US military launches 'powerful' retaliatory strikes on Iran
summary: The strikes come after Iranian attacks on US bases in Jordan, reigniting conflict in the Middle East and impacting global oil prices.
details: The United States military launched 'powerful' strikes on Iran on Thursday, responding to Tehran's previous attacks on US bases in Jordan. US Central Command described the operation as a direct response to attempted Iranian attacks on US forces in the Middle East.

Alongside these strikes, the US and Saudi Arabia conducted joint air operations against militant bases in Iraq. These operations targeted logistics and weapons sites of Iran-aligned groups, resulting in at least 20 deaths, including five Iranian advisors.

The escalation follows a period of tension over the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has blockaded and claimed full control over. The US has responded with new sanctions against entities linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards.
Global markets reacted sharply to the tension, with US stocks ending lower and oil prices jumping. The yield on 30-year US Treasury bonds reached its highest level since 2007.

Iraq has denounced the strikes as a violation of its sovereignty, while US President Trump stated the operations were coordinated with the Iraqi government. Iran's state media reported a US strike in the Piranshahr border area, though no casualties were reported there.
